page.title: Route Preview
page.purpose: Let an operator or agent test a role, profile, and constraint set before execution and inspect the selected route, rejected candidates, and policy reasons.

priorities.statement: Make the selected provider path and resource role obvious.
Explain rejected candidates with policy reasons instead of hiding them.
Keep execution separate from preview so operators can reason safely before running inference.

states.description: The preview form is ready and no preview result is required yet.
The route preview request is in flight.
Selected route, candidates, and policy reasons are visible.
The preview call failed and the error is visible.

claims.statement: The route preview page exposes a named operator region.
